# Upbit API

> Reverse-engineered internal API. Unofficial — may change without notice.

## Authentication
Unknown (may need login) — Authentication method detected from captured traffic.

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

## Dependencies
- Runtime capable of HTTPS requests.
- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

## Endpoints

### Data Read (14)
- `GET /api/kr_status.json` — Get the KR status JSON.
- `GET /api/v1/{v1Id}` — Get data from API v1 by ID.
- `GET /api/v1/emergency_popup/notice` — Get emergency popup notices.
- `GET /api/v1/kv/{kvId}` — Get a key-value pair by ID.
- `GET /upbit-home/api/v1/{v1Id}` — Get data from Upbit Home API by ID.
- `GET /upbit-home/api/v1/heatmap/sector` — Get heatmap sector data.
- `GET /v1/crix/candles/lines` — Get CRIX candle lines data.
- `GET /v1/crix/notice` — Get CRIX notices.
- `GET /v1/crix/recent/relatedMarkets` — Get recently related markets.
- `GET /v1/crix/trades/{tradeId}` — Get a specific CRIX trade by ID.
- `GET /v1/crix/tradingview/{tradingviewId}` — Get CRIX TradingView data by ID.
- `GET /v1/crix/trends/change_rate` — Get CRIX change rate trends.
- `GET /v1/forex/recent` — Get recent forex rates.
- `GET /v2/{v2Id}` — Get data from API v2 by ID.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Upbit's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Upbit data without official API access
- Automate actions on upbit.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Upbit frontend uses
